Returns the name of the next entry of a folder opened with [ReadDir](ReadDir). The names `.` and `..` are among them, and the order is up to the file system. An empty string means there are no more.

```blitzbasic
;run
CreateDir "files_next_example"
file = WriteFile("files_next_example/only.txt")
CloseFile file
dir = ReadDir("files_next_example")
Repeat
	name$ = NextFile$(dir)
	If name$ = "" Then Exit
	If name$ <> "." And name$ <> ".." Then Print name$
Forever
CloseDir dir
DeleteFile "files_next_example/only.txt"
DeleteDir "files_next_example"
```

```text
only.txt
```
@param dir  The folder handle from [ReadDir](ReadDir).
@returns A file or folder name without its path, or an empty string at the end.
